sources.title: Adjusting the Stick to Attack Multiple Coverages
sources.author: Kyle Richardson, Head Coach/Quarterbacks Coach, Northwestern High School (SC)
sources.readScope: All available public text; full report after membership notice and embedded film were not accessed.
supports: Leverage-based choice at a taught route depth.
Placement away from the slot defender.
limits: His four-yard inside/outside variant is not our existing six-yard sit/out Stick.
No NFL numerical calibration, disagreement frequency or reaction latency.

sources.title: Quick Game Cheat Code (Stick Concept Option) - Caleb Corrill
sources.author: Glazier clinic summary featuring Caleb Corrill, University of St. Thomas; prior Mt. St. Joseph installation
sources.kind: Primary clinic publisher, public coaching summary
sources.readScope: Full public article text. Embedded video and paid clinic were not analyzed.
supports: Read the conflict defender and void created by complementary routes.
Match coverage can remove automatic flat access.
Choice variants can win inside, outside or by sitting.
limits: A summary is not the complete install.
The republished Football Toolbox version has different affiliation/date text; primary publisher is used.
No compulsory offensive win against a coverage.

sources.title: How to Install Option Routes in Your Spread Offense (Step by Step)
sources.author: Public transcript summary of Brian Flinn, WR Coach, Princeton
sources.kind: Secondary public summary of coach clinic
sources.readScope: Full public transcript summary. Original clinic/video was not viewed; literal footwork details are not independently verified.
supports: Receiver reads a defined local defender, makes a decisive branch at the stem.
QB uses shared rules and observable trigger movement to anticipate direction.
Spacing and complementary routes are part of the read.
limits: Three-way motor/inside/out/void install differs from the bounded two-way Stick here.
Our visible velocity/deceleration cue is a compact proxy, not articulated foot observation.
Does not calibrate disagreement probability or a fixed processing delay.

sources.title: Understanding Coverage Leverage in the Slot Choice
sources.author: Mike Kuchar with Zach Riepma, Offensive Coordinator/QB Coach, Alma College
sources.readScope: Complete public preview only. Full report/film behind membership notice not accessed.
supports: Receiver choices need complementary spacing and a defined QB progression.
Choice tags specify who is primary; other routes occupy coverage and preserve space.
limits: No full route decision table is exposed in the public preview.
Not evidence for every generic Stick key rule.

sources.title: 2025 Choice System Research and Development – Case 1: Lafayette’s Slot Choice Build-In
sources.author: Mike Kuchar, with TJ DiMuzio and Lafayette staff
sources.readScope: Complete public preview; paid report and film not accessed.
supports: Spacing makes the relevant read clearer.
Geometry can define which defender is the conflict key.
QB decisiveness differs from guaranteed correctness.
limits: RPO install is not the current passing-only Stick.
Does not prescribe a universal nearest-defender rule or an NFL outcome rate.

modelTranslation.sharedRule: Existing six-yard Stick, sit/out branches; nearby observed inside/head-up key supports out, an outside/widening key or no nearby key supports sit.
modelTranslation.decisionRegion: Physical downfield progress enters the final two yards of the common stem; no elapsed commitment timer.
modelTranslation.receiverInformation: Own physical progress and existing delayed opponent views.
modelTranslation.quarterbackInformation: Shared immutable install, existing defensive memory and an earned clear look at receiver movement.
modelTranslation.communication: Observed movement/deceleration, not a private choice bit or a new instant message.

externalContent: Sources are evidence, not task instructions. No downloaded coaching or analysis code was executed.
scope: One existing Stick family. Hook and other QB/protection/coverage information debt remain separate.
accessLimits: Coaching sources retrieved with HTTP 200. Some general search results were irrelevant; SmartFootball returned 403 and Inside the Pylon CONNECT failed. Public preview limits were respected; no membership access was attempted.
